description: List menu items of one Korean franchise brand (e.g. 스타벅스, 맥도날드, 교촌치킨, 배스킨라빈스), sorted by kcal_asc (default), kcal_desc, protein_desc, sugar_asc or sodium_asc. Returns up to 20 items with serving size, calories and macros, the AI estimate flag where applicable, and the URL of the brand page that lists the full menu. Use query to narrow by part of the menu name. If the brand name is ambiguous, the matching brands are listed instead.

brand.description: Brand name as written in Korea, e.g. "스타벅스", "BBQ", "맘스터치"

query.description: Part of the menu name in Korean, e.g. "라떼", "버거"

sort.description: Sort order (default kcal_asc: lowest calories first)

name: franchise_menu
title: Franchise menu calories
